title: Balkan
tagline: Brass, strings, and rhythms shaped by the many musical traditions of Southeast Europe.
summary: Balkan music brings together diverse traditions from Southeast Europe, including brass bands, vocal styles, and dance rhythms. Modern performers often combine regional instruments and melodies with jazz, rock, and electronic production. The label describes a broad musical region rather than a single uniform genre.
origin_years: Traditional; contemporary revival from the 20th century

pillars.name: Goran Bregović
pillars.why: Bregović brought Balkan brass and folk influences into widely heard film scores and ensemble arrangements.

pillars.name: Esma Redžepova
pillars.why: Redžepova became an internationally recognized singer associated with Romani music from the Balkans.

pillars.name: Boban Marković
pillars.why: Marković is known for energetic Serbian brass-band performance and virtuoso trumpet playing.
